title: Spaces of subobjects as spectral spaces
summary: We study natural topologies on spaces of subobjects of a fixed object in a suitable category, with the aim of determining when these spaces are spectral. A central step in our approach, which is also of independent interest, is the comparison between the categorical notion of a $λ$-generated object and the order-theoretic notion of a $λ$-compact element in a lattice of subobjects. We prove that these notions coincide under some natural and mild assumptions .
